decision_authority: Initial meta thread; explicit Aru and Norfolk macro membership decisions. Candidate sheet requires global integration/publication before worker gate opens.

groups.name: Oceania
groups.convention: Expanded six-continent atlas association: Australia, New Zealand, named Pacific archipelagos and explicitly associated subantarctic Indian Ocean islands. Antarctica excluded.

shared_edges.rule: Asia includes Sunda/Wallacea and all named Moluccan islands outside New Guinea-associated Sahul scope; Oceania includes whole New Guinea, New Guinea-associated offshore islands and Aru. Christmas/Cocos Asian Indian Ocean associations retained. No sovereignty or blanket longitude line.
Hawaii/Midway/Johnston/Line/Phoenix/Micronesian island groups Oceania; Clipperton under explicit eastern-Pacific American association. No US/French owner assignment.
Rapa Nui/Sala y Gomez and Pitcairn Oceania; Galapagos/Juan Fernandez under American eastern-Pacific association. Political Chile affiliation does not move Rapa Nui.

required_changes.source_province_role: Geographic portion, not a newly invented government division

groups.name: Australasia
groups.convention: Australia and New Zealand/Southwest Pacific named land associations. The Australia/NZ regional boundary separates Lord Howe from Norfolk explicitly; it does not follow sovereign ownership.

required_changes.reason: Norfolk Ridge island group between New Zealand/New Caledonia; independent of Australian sovereignty. Retain nearer eastern-Australia Lord Howe geographic association.

groups.name: Polynesia
groups.convention: Western, north-central Hawaiian/Johnston, and central/eastern Polynesian archipelago associations.

groups.name: Melanesia
groups.convention: Whole New Guinea and adjacent Sahul islands, Bismarck/Solomon, southern Melanesian island chains.

required_changes.source_province_role: Geographic portion, not a newly invented government division

groups.name: Subantarctic Indian Ocean Islands
groups.convention: Heard/McDonald, Kerguelen, Crozet, Amsterdam/Saint-Paul; remote southern Indian Ocean group.

groups.name: Australia
groups.convention: Australian mainland/Tasmania, adjacent shelf/Torres Strait/Coral Sea islands, Jervis Bay and named nearer eastern-Australia Lord Howe association. Norfolk/Phillip/Nepean belongs NZ/Southwest Pacific; Christmas/Cocos belongs Asia.

shared_edges.rule: Lord Howe and Australian shelf/Tasman associations stay Australia; Norfolk/Phillip/Nepean, Macquarie and enumerated NZ-outlying groups follow NZ/SW Pacific. No ocean polygon or sovereign boundary assigned.
Australian shelf/Torres Strait association versus New Guinea/Sahul including Aru; no political owner test.

required_changes.reason: Norfolk Ridge island group between New Zealand/New Caledonia; independent of Australian sovereignty. Retain nearer eastern-Australia Lord Howe geographic association.

includes: Torres Strait islands and Australian shelf coastal islands
fixed_land_scope.rule: Ocean water is outside the land domain. Retain Lord Howe as the nearer eastern-Australia/Tasman island association; explicitly relocate Norfolk ridge island group to the Southwest Pacific association. Existing state borders are not macro-region ownership borders.

groups.name: South-Central Pacific
groups.convention: Cook northern/southern islands, Phoenix including Howland/Baker, Line, French Polynesian groups, Pitcairn four-island group, Rapa Nui.

shared_edges.rule: Cook/Phoenix/Line/French Polynesian/Pitcairn/Rapa Nui associations South-Central; Tonga/Tuvalu/Tokelau-Swains/Samoa/Wallis-Futuna/Niue Western.
Hawaiian/Johnston North-Central; Phoenix/Howland/Baker/Line South-Central; geographic latitude alone is not the rule.

includes: Northern and Southern Cook Islands (all 15 named islands)
True Phoenix Islands and associated Howland/Baker
Rapa Nui/Easter Island and Sala y Gomez association
fixed_land_scope.rule: Central/eastern Polynesian named archipelago scope; true Phoenix routes here, not Equatorial Micronesia or Hawaiian/Johnston North-Central Pacific. Southern Line and missing Pitcairn/Cook islands may be restored inside this scope without changing macro membership.

groups.name: Southern Melanesian Islands
groups.convention: Fiji including geographically associated Rotuma, Santa Cruz, Vanuatu, New Caledonia.

includes: Santa Cruz/Temotu island association including Reef, Duff, Vanikoro, Utupua, Tikopia and Anuta
New Caledonia island association including Loyalty and associated named offshore islands
fixed_land_scope.rule: Named geographic island associations remain fixed despite Melanesian/Polynesian cultural outliers and Zealandia geology; cultural identity and sovereignty do not define region membership.

groups.name: Northwestern Pacific
groups.convention: Caroline/Palau/FSM, Marshall Islands, Marianas/Guam/CNMI, Wake named associations.

includes: Mariana Islands including Guam and Northern Marianas
fixed_land_scope.rule: Named archipelago boundaries, no owner-wide US or Kiribati assignment; all islands of named groups follow their regional association, including currently missing source land.

groups.name: Papuasia
groups.convention: Whole New Guinea, adjacent Sahul islands including Aru, Bismarck and main Solomon archipelago including Bougainville/Buka; exclude Santa Cruz/Temotu association.

shared_edges.rule: Whole New Guinea and Aru Oceania; Wallacea/Moluccan association excluding Aru Asia. Restoration cannot transfer an unreviewed source-province remainder.
Main Solomon chain/Bougainville/Buka Papuasia; Santa Cruz/Temotu named island association Southern Melanesian Islands.

required_changes.source_province_role: Geographic portion, not a newly invented government division

includes: New Guinea-associated Sahul offshore islands including Raja Ampat, Yapen, Biak, Aru and southeastern coastal/island extensions
Bismarck Archipelago including Admiralty, New Britain, New Ireland and intervening named islands
Main Solomon archipelago including Bougainville/Buka and associated named offshore islands
excludes: Wallacea/Moluccan islands west of Sahul association except Aru
fixed_land_scope.rule: No Indonesian/PNG/Solomon sovereignty boundary divides membership. Whole New Guinea and Aru are Oceania; transitional Wallacea remains Asia under fixed atlas convention. Southern-Melanesia transition follows named Santa Cruz/Temotu island association, not owner.

groups.name: New Zealand and Southwest Pacific Islands
groups.convention: NZ main/coastal islands, Chatham/Kermadec/Auckland/Campbell/Antipodes/Snares/Bounty, Macquarie and Norfolk/Phillip/Nepean southwestern Pacific association; exclude Cook/Niue/Tokelau despite NZ ties.

required_changes.reason: Norfolk Ridge island group between New Zealand/New Caledonia; independent of Australian sovereignty. Retain nearer eastern-Australia Lord Howe geographic association.

includes: North/South/Stewart islands and adjacent New Zealand coastal islands
fixed_land_scope.rule: Named southwestern Pacific island association; no extension to NZ/Australian dependent territories merely because of ownership. Norfolk Ridge location between NZ/New Caledonia supports association; published island identity controls restoration.

groups.name: North-Central Pacific
groups.convention: Hawaiian chain including Midway, plus separate Johnston atoll association.

includes: Main and Northwestern Hawaiian chain including Midway
Johnston Atoll group as separate named association
fixed_land_scope.rule: Region is the named Hawaiian/northern-central association, not an arbitrary ocean latitude band. Johnston is not called Hawaii; political affiliation irrelevant.

groups.name: Southern Indian Ocean Islands
groups.convention: Heard/McDonald, Kerguelen, Crozet, Amsterdam/Saint-Paul. Excludes Macquarie and Antarctic mainland/Adelie Land.

excludes: Antarctic continent and Antarctic-associated Adelie land
fixed_land_scope.rule: Explicit southern Indian Ocean island association; Oceania parent is a stated six-continent atlas convention for remote southern islands after Antarctica exclusion, not an objectively unique physical-continent fact.

groups.name: Western Polynesian Islands
groups.convention: Tonga, Tuvalu, Tokelau/Swains, Samoa/American Samoa, Wallis/Futuna, Niue.

includes: Samoan archipelago including Samoa/American Samoa and Rose
fixed_land_scope.rule: Fixed named western Polynesian island crosswalk. Swains follows Tokelau archipelago despite administration; Cook northern islands do not follow Tokelau or NZ ownership.

groups.name: Equatorial Micronesia
groups.convention: Gilbert Islands including Banaba and associated western residual land; Nauru.

shared_edges.rule: Gilbert/Banaba Micronesia; actual Phoenix/Howland/Baker and Line South-Central Pacific/Polynesia. False western Phoenix source label confers no eastern assignment.

fixed_land_scope.rule: Gilbert/Banaba geography east of western-Pacific source remainder controls membership. Current wrongly labeled Phoenix source remainder stays geographically here pending identity repair; it does not substitute for actual Phoenix.

facts: Australia/New Zealand and Melanesia/Micronesia/Polynesia including Hawaii; opening statement mentions eastern New Guinea by polity and does not settle western New Guinea.
Aru lies on the Australia-New Guinea continental shelf and shares Australasian biogeographic affinities; continental grouping is distinct from Indonesian ownership.
Whole New Guinea island shares Australian continental shelf; formerly connected Sahul; contemporary sovereignty does not divide the island geological identity.
Deep-water transitional islands between Sunda and Sahul shelves; includes Sulawesi and Lesser Sunda islands. Asia association requires declared atlas convention.
Gilbert Islands/Nauru belong to Micronesia; Kiribati Phoenix/Line islands belong to Polynesia under geographic convention.
Includes Fiji/Vanuatu/Solomon/New Guinea/New Caledonia; whole Indonesian New Guinea included. Cultural Torres Strait association need not override declared Australia shelf region.
Hawaii/Rapa Nui/NZ triangle; Phoenix/Line often considered Polynesian; shared geography differs from political ownership and NZ may remain Australasia under atlas subregion convention.
Eight named Kiribati atolls east of Gilbert/west of Line, around 4.5S/172W, Polynesia. Howland/Baker are geographically associated; retained western-Pacific source remainder is not actual Phoenix.
Eleven named confirmed islands/atolls, eight Kiribati and three US: Jarvis/Kingman/Palmyra. Polynesian group spans owners.
Swains belongs to geographic Tokelau archipelago despite American Samoa administration.
Macquarie lies halfway between Tasmania and Antarctica; southwestern Pacific association is an explicit atlas convention, not Indian Ocean geography.
Between NZ and New Caledonia, about 1412km east of Australian Evans Head, 900km from Lord Howe; on Norfolk Ridge/Zealandia. Australia regional association needs an explicit Tasman island convention.
Melanesia subregion though Zealandia geology; geology and cultural/archipelago conventions do not yield identical subdivisions.
Four islands Pitcairn/Henderson/Ducie/Oeno; Henderson 86% of area, Pitcairn only inhabited; Adamstown 25.067S/130.100W differs from current single footprint.
Fifteen islands in Polynesia; current eleven named atlas locations do not certify complete coverage.

All fifteen names in proposed north/south Cook crosswalk checked against fetched page text: Aitutaki, Atiu, Mangaia, Manuae, Mauke, Mitiaro, Palmerston, Rarotonga, Takutea, Manihiki, Nassau, Penrhyn, Pukapuka, Rakahanga, Suwarrow.
Competing North America/Oceania associations; proximity to Mexico and eastern-Pacific convention can justify chosen North America assignment but alternative is explicit.
Subantarctic southern Indian Ocean archipelago around 46.38S/51.67E.
Southern Indian Ocean subantarctic archipelago; geographic fact does not uniquely assign a continent.
Southern Indian Ocean island at about 37.8S/77.6E.
Southern Indian Ocean island associated with Amsterdam named district.
Southern Indian Ocean volcanic islands around 53.075S/73.5E.
Tokelau comprises Atafu, Nukunonu and Fakaofo. All three names checked in fetched text. Current atlas source shape has only two atoll components; Nukunonu absent.

New Zealand subantarctic Bounty archipelago around 47.75S/179E; part of NZ geographic outlying islands. Current atlas has Auckland/Campbell/Antipodes/Kermadec/Snares source locations but no Bounty location.

Northern Line land only. Source does not certify southern Line completeness.

Fakaofo/Atafu present; third Tokelau atoll Nukunonu absent. All route to Western Polynesian Islands.

original_source_limitations: WGSRPD is a botanical recording geography and supplies candidate names, not automatic semantic approval. Contemporary owner affiliations cannot define regional territory.
Current member footprint unions omit real islands. They are represented subsets, never a complete approved outer envelope by themselves.
Kiribati Phoenix source ID actually contains two western-Pacific/Gilbert components. Renaming exposed mismatch but did not restore true Phoenix.
Current Line source contains northern Line components, omits southern Line; Kingman absent from named source locations.
Current Pitcairn source footprint is Henderson only; population of Adamstown/Pitcairn cannot be imported against Henderson.
Current Cook source contains eleven named islands versus fifteen in group; missing Manuae/Takutea/Nassau/Suwarrow remain open.
Current Tokelau source represents Atafu/Fakaofo but not Nukunonu; geographic label alone does not establish all-atoll coverage.
Current NZ outlying source inventory lacks Bounty; named association is fixed before restoration.
Subantarctic Indian Ocean islands under Oceania are an explicit six-continent atlas association after Antarctica exclusion; sources establish oceanic location, not an objectively unique continent.

domain_contract.reference_context: Modern reference land and coastlines; dated geography is separately sourced. Ocean/EEZ/water cells are outside territorial land domain.
domain_contract.authoritative_scope: Region fixed_land_scope and named_land_routing, corroborated by listed source geographic identities. Existing member polygons are incomplete representation assets, not definition of complete scope.
regional_worker_allowed_changes: Restore licensed source geometry for explicitly routed named islands within its region
Review/subdivide local territories and replace source granularity inside fixed regional land association
Improve shoreline precision without transferring land to another regional association; retain source hashes and predecessor crosswalks
regional_worker_prohibited_changes: Assign missing land by sovereign owner or nearest-centroid fallback
Move a named island/archipelago between regions or reinterpret a shared edge
Approve lower-tier locations or content readiness from this candidate macro sheet alone
domain_contract.unlisted_or_ambiguous_land: Inspect authoritative archipelago identity against this scope. If it is not unambiguously part of a listed association, request a joint macro correction before assigning; do not silently expand one region.
domain_contract.boundary_precision: Named island/archipelago membership is frozen independently of internal subdivisions. Exact land geometry restoration uses independently licensed shoreline/source evidence and must retain precision/coverage uncertainty; missing land is explicitly open.
domain_contract.represented_route_semantics: represented:true identifies checked land in explicit source location IDs, not complete group coverage. Region membership is checked against migrated hierarchy; represented:false routes remain fixed but missing/unverified.
